articles.title: Tenants need £75k income to rent in London – claim
articles.summary: This is according to Propertymark, the letting agents’ trade body
articles.ai_summary:
- Tenants in London now require an annual income of £75,000 to secure rental accommodations, as reported by Propertymark.
- The rising income threshold highlights the growing affordability crisis in the capital's rental market.

articles.title: Shelter slams Tory rental idea as “unworkable”
articles.summary: The charity's deputy director has criticised the idea
articles.ai_summary:
- Shelter's deputy director labels the Tory rental proposal as "unworkable," highlighting significant concerns about its feasibility.
- The charity's critique underscores growing frustrations with government housing policies and their impact on renters.

articles.title: Landlord taxes fail to invigorate local markets – claim
articles.summary: Council tax premiums on second homes have failed to deliver stronger rental markets
articles.ai_summary:
- Council tax premiums on second homes haven't boosted local rental markets as intended.  
- Landlords argue that increased taxes aren't driving the expected market invigorations.

articles.title: Landlords who sell can estimate their property’s value
articles.summary: Landlords can justify their valuation with comments to the agent, too
articles.ai_summary:
- Landlords can now estimate their property's value when selling, offering greater control over the selling process.
- Improved communication with agents allows landlords to support their valuation with personal insights.

articles.title: Major property shows combine as costs squeeze organisers
articles.ai_summary:

- Exhibitors are pushing for broader audience reach, highlighting the need for larger platforms to showcase their offerings effectively.

articles.title: Landlords lose billions as tenant fraudsters run rampant

articles.ai_summary:

- Research by Goodlord highlights the financial strain on property owners due to increasing incidents of rogue tenant activities.

articles.title: Landlord ignores council waste advice and pays a heavy price
articles.summary: The case arose following complaints from neighbours
articles.ai_summary:

articles.title: Housing market stuck in summer doldrums
articles.summary: Annual price growth is now the slowest for over two and a half years
articles.ai_summary:
- The UK housing market is experiencing its slowest annual price growth in over 30 months.  
- Current conditions are characterized by a stagnant market, reflecting a persistent summer lull.

articles.title: Labour Mayor’s spending bonanza to fight “unfair rent increases”
articles.summary: The public money is being spent by Sir Sadiq Khan, Labour Mayor of London
articles.ai_summary:

- The initiative aims to provide financial relief to tenants facing escalating housing costs amid the capital's rental crisis.

articles.title: Insurance costs for property types revealed in new survey
articles.summary: The analysis has been undertaken. by Uswitch

articles.title: Free maintenance reporting tech for small-scale landlords
articles.summary: The offer applies only to landlord with four or fewer buy to let properties
